# What this skill does

This page is a **live demonstration** of the report that the `nbis-folium`
skill scaffolds. It is built from the same Roy Francis
[folium-webpage](https://github.com/royfrancis/folium-webpage) Quarto template that the
skill uses, so the NBIS branding, banner, logo, and section styling you see here
are exactly what a real NBIS project report gets.

The skill:

- Scaffolds an NBIS project report from the `folium` (multi-page) or
  `folium-webpage` (single self-contained page) Quarto template
- Installs the required Quarto extensions at pinned versions (fontawesome,
  collapse-output, accordion)
- Fills in the NBIS metadata, putting the project title in `subtitle` so that
  `title` keeps deriving from the NBIS ID as the templates intend
- Leaves a visible `TODO` for anything it was not told, rather than inventing a
  name or an email address
- Adds a GitHub Actions workflow that renders and publishes to GitHub Pages,
  supporting `renv`, pip, or `pixi`
- Inlines the NBIS SciLifeLab logo as SVG markup (no external asset dependency)
  so it renders correctly in standalone HTML
- Renders once to verify before reporting success

# How to install

```bash
npx skills add pyrevo/nbis-folium-skill
```

That installs three skills, so you immediately get two commands and only have to
decide which shape of report you want:

- `/folium-page` — one single self-contained HTML page, like this one
- `/folium-site` — a multi-page website with a sidebar and a completion page

Both aim to ask nothing. If Quarto is installed and the target directory is
empty, the agent scaffolds, configures, and renders without stopping. It
interrupts only for project metadata it cannot invent, or if the directory
already holds work.

Prefer a site with a sidebar, separate report pages, and a completion page?
[View the multi-page `folium` demo](https://pyrevo.github.io/nbis-folium-skill/folium/).

# Example scaffold layout

A report scaffolded by the skill looks like this:

```
project/
├── index.qmd            # single page; folium instead has _quarto.yml + reports/
├── assets/
│   ├── include_logo.html   # the inline-SVG standalone-logo fix
│   └── ...
├── _extensions/         # fontawesome, collapse-output, accordion (pinned)
├── .github/
│   └── workflows/
│       └── deploy-pages.yml
├── .gitignore           # ignores the render output and .quarto/
└── report/              # rendered output, produced by the verification render
```

# Agent compatibility

The skill works with agents that can read the installed skill directory and run
shell commands (for example OpenCode, Claude Code, and Codex). It is not a
self-contained pasted prompt: the mechanical half of the work lives in a bundled
`scripts/scaffold.sh`, and the standalone-logo fix is a bundled template file
that must be copied verbatim.

On agents that expose skills as slash commands, `/folium-page` and `/folium-site`
appear with no extra step. Agents that keep commands in their own directory can
install them with the bundled `scripts/install-commands.sh`.
